messages:
Alex (PM): heads up — we need a converged PRD acceptance checklist for the audit/hardened deployment track. major asks from 2 customers + SOC2/ISO gating. can we do a quick sync here?
Mira (Security): +1. main risk areas: audit logs (immutable, tamper-evidence), customer-specific KMS keys/HSM integration, retention config and secure deletion controls.
Sam (Eng): got it. curious what the minimum viable scope is for launch vs. stretch. HSM integration adds ops complexity.
Nina (Compliance): for SOC2 readiness we need: retained audit trail (at least 90 days by default), proof of integrity, role-based access to log exports, and evidence of key management policies. ISO needs similar but docs more prescriptive.
Alex (PM): suggestion: MVP = platform-level encrypted logs with append-only store + API to export logs, KMS-managed keys (cloud KMS) for hosted; stretch = HSM-backed keys + per-customer key separation for Private/Dedicated. thoughts?
Mira (Security): MVP caveat: cloud KMS only ok for hosted, but we must surface a well-defined failure mode: if KMS unavailable, we should continue to accept requests and buffer logs locally encrypted with a fallback key, then re-encrypt on key restoration. must be explicit in acceptance criteria.
Sam (Eng): buffering okay but we need limits: no more than 6 hours of unreplayed buffered logs, and backpressure if disk > 80%. also need a migration plan for re-encrypting buffered logs.
Lee (QA): edge cases to capture in PRD tests: 1) rollover during high-throughput (10k reqs/s) 2) incomplete writes when node restarts 3) key rotation mid-retention window 4) export with redaction rules.
Mira (Security): agree. add: HSM requirement for Private deployments handling regulated PII — customer must opt-in, flag in onboarding. also require KMS rotation policy documented with rotation cadence (default 90 days) and rotation audit.
Nina (Compliance): retention policy must be configurable per-customer from 90 days to 7 years, with an admin audit trail for retention changes. also need retention-deletion proof (deletion receipts) for audits.
Alex (PM): ok compiling acceptance criteria draft. posting quick checklist below — please react with :thumbsup: if acceptable or add one-line change.
Alex (PM): ```Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Audit logs: append-only, tamper-evident, searchable for at least 90 days by default
- Export: API to export logs (CSV/NDJSON) with RBAC and time-window filters
- KMS: supported cloud KMS for hosted; config to integrate HSM for Private; keys rotatable with audit trail
- Failover: if KMS unavailable, buffer encrypted logs, replay within 6h; platform must not drop logs silently
- Retention: per-customer retention setting (90d–7y); deletion receipts generated and auditable
- Tests: load test at 10k rps, node restart consistency, key-rotation scenario coverage
```
Mira (Security): quick note: add requirement that logs are signed or hashed with an immutable ledger entry (can be internal Merkle root per hour) to prove tamper-evidence.
Sam (Eng): implementation sketch: use append-only S3 objects + per-hour manifest with Merkle root. KMS encrypts the objects. HSM path maps to envelope keys stored in HSM. estimate: MVP ~3 sprints, HSM path + per-customer keys ~2 sprints extra.
Lee (QA): will draft test matrix from the acceptance criteria. also add regression alerting: if export latency > 2min or buffer backlog > 30min, create P1.
Nina (Compliance): also require docs: operational runbook for key compromise, customer notification SLAs, and evidence artefacts for auditors.
Alex (PM): thanks — I'll update the PRD section and tag owners. Mira, Sam, can you confirm feasibility of the Merkle-hour approach and buffering limits by EOD?
Mira (Security): confirming feasibility, will follow up with a short RFC for signing scheme.
Sam (Eng): confirm feasibility for MVP buffering/manifest plan. will add cost estimate and infra impact in RFC.
deploy-bot: created issue #4521: "prd: audit-hardened-deploy acceptance checklist" assigned to Alex (PM).
Alex (PM): perfect — next step: I will convert checklist into PRD acceptance table and link to RFCs. if no objections, plan to gate feature rollout behind these checks for the Q4 release. :white_check_mark:
